title: Ghar Lut Gaya Rasool
body:
ghar lut gaya rasool ka amma ab aayi ho
bhai shaheed hogaya amma ab aayi ho
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bataye qasim e nausha ki dastaan
bikhre pade hai phool zameen par yahan wahan
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
atthara saal paala tha jisko khushi khushi
qurban wo bhi kar gaya sarwar pa zindagi
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghutniyo bhi chalne ka khaabil abhi na tha
wo bhi qaza ke haathon se bejaan hogaya
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai pa mere laal bhi qurban ho gaye
qabza kiya furaat par be-aab so gaye
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala may aa ke uthayi wo saktiyan
cheeni gayi sakina ke kaano se baaliyan
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ye sochti rahi zainab ke bain par
kya kya sitam huwe hai hamare hussain par
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bain kis zaban se ishrat karun raqam
ye likhte likhte ashq bahane laga qalam
zainab ka ye bayaan tha amma ab aayi ho
ghar lut gaya rasool ka...
bhai shaheed hogaya...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
